correctness.rationale: Six exact joint-inclusion probability types imply the 2-by-2 row covariance tensored with the double-contrast projector. The exact 2-by-2 eigenvalues yield all multiplicities, kernel and sharp visible condition number. Two independent enumeration strategies verified all pair classes and mode energies for orders 2–5; the proof applies to all n≥3.

value.rationale: Complete all-order Fourier sampling stability for a canonical family of pairs of disjoint perfect matchings, not an arbitrary small enumeration. It proves that deterministic line-sum identities exhaust the kernel, locates the two genuinely distinct noise-amplification sectors, and gives sharp convergence to tightness at rate O(1/n).
